correctness.rationale: Every extremizer of the mixed bounded functional is outer by Brevig--Søvik (2026); its analytic qth root is a unit H2 function, whose first three coefficients admit an exact global F(x,y,w) upper bound. Fixed-x optimization yields w=min(x/(q-1),sqrt(1-x²)), and the resulting two one-variable functions have a unique maximum, with transition τ=1/(q-2). Both quadratic equality cases are zero-free by the Schur criterion, normalized, and exhaust equality cases. Exact support planes give Φ2 on the declared interval, and the proved high-origin formula for Φ1 shows equality exactly for t>=tstar with strict gap immediately below. Noninteger powers and endpoints were included. The standalone checker passed 94,010 finite assertions but is not used to prove the continuum result.

value.rationale: Solves the published order-two terminal-equality problem for the entire natural range 0<p<1, not merely one exponent. Exact mixed coefficient support-functionals and all norming extremizers provide structural information about bifurcation of Hardy extrema; the fixed-origin frontier is a motivated geometric invariant and the sharp threshold is an existing explicit mathematical question. This is not an arbitrary slice, a renamed corollary, or a numerical increment.
